GROUP: emission_cleanup.rs (record 067): | 28. 2274-2276: on ambiguous captures the unresolved carrier is used, so an overlap reached through two spellings would not be seen at 2852-2861.
GROUP: emission_cleanup.rs (record 067): | 29. 4903-4912: source-checked obligations that no instance renamed are kept verbatim.
